verdict.rationale: Mercury directly claims it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite and uses AI-powered automations to close books faster. Supporting features include AI bill reading, automatic receipt matching to card transactions, and transaction categorization through the API and MCP. Category endpoints and an agent skill for receipt upload are also documented. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what the close automations do (e.g. auto-categorization rules, reconciliation, sync behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that close time actually shrinks.
